name: Floating Sticky Notes
description: Add floating sticky notes to the site.
project_description:
The Floating Sticky Notes module provides a simple and interactive way for users to create and manage sticky notes directly within a Drupal site.

 Installation 
 Install the module using Composer, Drush, or by downloading it manually from Drupal.org.

 Add the Sticky Notes Block 
 
 Navigate to Structure → Block Layout. 
 Place the Sticky Notes Block in the desired region of your theme. 
 Save the block configuration. 
 
 Sticky Notes Icon 
 Once the block is placed, a sticky notes icon will appear on the page. This icon serves as the entry point for accessing the sticky notes interface.

 Create and Manage Notes 
 
 Click the sticky notes icon to open the notes panel. 
 Create, edit, and save your notes directly from the interface. 
 Saved notes remain available for future access. 
 
 Notes Listing 
 The module also provides a dedicated listing page /admin/content/sticky-notes where users can view all created notes from a single location.
